title: AIR STRIKE PLATE AT 4K
why: A fix to the air strike meter: its plate was sized in the small HUD units while its words were drawn at the screen size, so on a 4K screen the words would have outgrown the plate. The plate, its bar and the callout over the aim ring now all scale with the screen the way the raid status panel does.
now: The air strike meter plate now grows with the screen, so it fits at 4K.
